lifecycle.verify_cmd: ros2 pkg prefix nav2_bringup >/dev/null && ros2 pkg prefix turtlebot3_gazebo >/dev/null && ros2 interface show nav_msgs/msg/OccupancyGrid >/dev/null
lifecycle.start_cmd: bash -lc "source /opt/ros/foxy/setup.bash; cp /opt/ros/foxy/share/nav2_bringup/params/nav2_params.yaml /tmp/nav2_deadlock_3109_params.yaml; sed -i 's|yaml_filename: .*|yaml_filename: \"/opt/ros/foxy/share/nav2_bringup/maps/turtlebot3_world.yaml\"|' /tmp/nav2_deadlock_3109_params.yaml; sed -i 's/use_sim_time: True/use_sim_time: False/g' /tmp/nav2_deadlock_3109_params.yaml; sed -i 's/update_frequency: 1.0/update_frequency: 5.0/g' /tmp/nav2_deadlock_3109_params.yaml; sed -i 's/publish_frequency: 1.0/publish_frequency: 5.0/g' /tmp/nav2_deadlock_3109_params.yaml; ros2 run tf2_ros static_transform_publisher 0 0 0 0 0 0 map base_link >/tmp/nav2_deadlock_tf.log 2>&1 & ros2 run nav2_map_server map_server --ros-args -r __node:=map_server --params-file /tmp/nav2_deadlock_3109_params.yaml >/tmp/nav2_deadlock_map.log 2>&1 & ros2 run nav2_planner planner_server --ros-args -r __node:=planner_server --params-file /tmp/nav2_deadlock_3109_params.yaml >/tmp/nav2_deadlock_planner.log 2>&1 & ros2 run nav2_lifecycle_manager lifecycle_manager --ros-args -r __node:=lifecycle_manager_nav3109 -p use_sim_time:=False -p autostart:=True -p node_names:='[map_server,planner_server]' >/tmp/nav2_deadlock_lm.log 2>&1 & while true; do sleep 3600; done"
lifecycle.stop_cmd: pkill -x planner_server || true; pkill -x map_server || true; pkill -x lifecycle_manager || true; pkill -x static_transform_publisher || true; pkill -x gzserver || true; pkill -x gzclient || true; pkill -x gazebo || true
